First, I should start by understanding what a prefill/decode cluster is. It's a part of the neural network where data is preprocessed before being sent to the GPU. Disaggregation here means splitting the workload into separate parts, which can help manage resources better.

Request routing is the process of directing incoming requests to the appropriate prefill/decode nodes. Queueing would involve managing the flow of requests through these nodes. Tail latency refers to the time a request takes to complete after being processed. Cache transfer is about moving data between the cache and the prefill/decode nodes
